text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: infra-oncall paged for SEV2 - high p99 tail latency observed on shared-gpu-pool-3 for streaming requests. Alerts: streaming-stalls >= 15% across region-us-west1.

infra-oncall: oncall here. seeing p95 450ms -> 1.6s, p99 ~6.1s for streaming endpoints. Retrying requests are increasing backlog.

ravi: confirming metrics from perf-dash: host2/host5 show GPU PCIe utilization spikes and blkio write latency rising to 120ms. cgroup root shows tenant "t-842" using 72% of host IO.

ashley: customer-impact? any SLO breaches reported externally?

ryan-cs: CS: two customers (acct-241, acct-900) reported streaming stalls and partial transcript truncation. Both are on shared pool. We'll prep status drafts after mitigation.

matt: logs from the runtime:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:12Z] stream: conn=xx client=acct-241 token=*** tail-latency=6100ms stall=true
[2026-03-15T18:02:30Z] kv-cache: eviction=high tenant=t-842 rate=4200/s
[2026-03-15T18:02:45Z] host2: cgroup.io.write_lat=112ms cgroup.read_lat=30ms
```

liz: quick triage checklist: 1) isolate offending tenant 2) throttle IO via cgroup 3) evict large KV prefixes 4) route critical customers to dedicated pool 5) if needed, evacuate host.

infra-oncall: Agreed. Doing step 1 now: marking tenant t-842 as noisy and applying IO qdisc and cgroup limits. Running command:
```
sudo cgset -r blkio.throttle.write_bps_device="8:0 10485760" /tenant-t842
sudo tc qdisc add dev nvme0 root tbf rate 80mbit burst 32k latency 50ms
```

deploy-bot: deploy log: applied cgroup update to tenant-t842 on host2 at 18:05:06Z.

ravi: confirmed cgroup change pushed. write latency dropping from 112ms -> 36ms over 30s. GPU utilization remains bursty but IO spike subsided.

matt: meanwhile, routing rule to move high-SLO customers to dedicated-pool-d1:
```
api-route update --selector "acct in (acct-241,acct-900)" --backend dedicated-pool-d1 --force
```
api-route: routing change accepted, traffic draining from shared pool over 18s.

ryan-cs: notifying affected customers: draft message ready. Will wait until we confirm stabilization for public note.

infra-oncall: also evicting large KV entries for tenant-t842 to free KV cache:
```
kvtool evict --tenant t-842 --prefix user:session: --max-keys 20000
```
kvtool: evict submitted, progress 42%.

ashley: any signs this is multi-host? hosts reporting host5 also had spikes earlier. Should we consider full pool throttling?

ravi: host5 shows similar IO pattern but tenant mapping shows t-842 had tasks on both. After cgroup throttle on host2, host5 still has 30% higher IOPS. I'll push soft throttle there too.

infra-oncall: applied throttle to host5. p95 now 320ms, p99 900ms and trending down. Streaming stall % dropped from 15% -> 3% in last 60s.

liz: good. next: create incident timeline and assign follow-ups. Who owns tenant remediation?

matt: platform-eng to own postmortem for noisy-tenant detection + automatic tenant throttling playbook. I'll file card and assign.

ryan-cs: Status update to customers: "We experienced elevated streaming latency due to a noisy tenant in a shared GPU pool. We've isolated the tenant, applied IO throttles, and routed critical customers to dedicated capacity. We're monitoring and will share a post-incident summary." Sending now.

deploy-bot: route rollback not required. No deployments in progress.

ravi: monitoring shows KV eviction finished. cache pressure down 78%. p99 now 420ms steady for 5m.

infra-oncall: I'll keep the incident open for 2h for stability, then start tenant eviction if noise returns. Moving to SEV2 -> mitigated.

matt: follow-ups: (1) automated noisy-tenant detection alert (threshold: tenant IO > 60% host) (2) safe-evacuation playbook update (3) add fallback routing for streaming-critical customers to dedicated pool when host-level streaming-sla breaches p99 > 1s.

liz: also request CS to reach out follow-up with timeline and remediation steps.

ryan-cs: will schedule customer calls and send the incident summary at 19:30Z.

ashley: closing loop with SRE: did we need an immediate host evacuation? seems avoidable. Good job on quick throttle.

infra-oncall: thanks all. closing thread in 2h unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident note added to PD: SEV2 mitigated by per-tenant cgroup throttling and routing changes.

matt: filing postmortem card now: PM-4219 (noisy-tenant-gpu-io-20260315).

liz: add action owner @ravi for automation and @matt for playbook update.

ravi: ack. I'll start drafting automation RFC today.

ryan-cs: thanks team.

infra-oncall: signing off from active mitigation - will hand to rotations for watch.
